issues.description: WIN-011.c3 hole 1: strategic reframing opportunity. Yang & Wang (2002) self-retraction makes the argument closer to refutation than "Not Demonstrated". Curmudgeon preemptive recommendation: re-center the WIN-011 thrust on the dome's SPECIFIC self-retracted value (not the Allais effect in general) to defeat the intermittency rebuttal. Lead with Yang & Wang 2002 self-retraction; keep Van Camp as corroboration; add cross-event cherry-pick point (BOU 2017 + Mohe 1997 are different eclipses/continents/instruments). Verdict stays Not Demonstrated for now (curmudgeon verdict_holds=true) but argument order should change.
issues.suggested_fix: Analyst EXP: reorder detail_evidence to lead with Yang & Wang 2002 self-retraction. Add sentence: -6.5 μGal (Mohe 1997) and -10.9 nT (BOU 2017) are from different eclipses, different continents, different instruments, 20 years apart — cross-event cherry-pick, not a co-measured ratio. Optionally consider tightening verdict to Self-Contradicted if evidence warrants.

issues.suggested_fix: Remove the empty stub entries for ISS-2599/2600/2602-2606 from closed-issues.json. For ISS-2605 cross-file: either close the open entry (if the fix is complete) or remove the closed stub. Investigate decider allocator for the double-write bug (creating stub then populated entry with same ID).

issues.title: expansion-tracker.json next_id=596 collision: EXP-596 already exists as live entry
issues.description: expansion-tracker.json has next_id=596, but EXP-596 already exists as a live item (status=complete, category=win-rewrite, target=WIN-042, created 2026-06-06T23:17:32Z). The allocator did not increment next_id after allocating EXP-596. The next allocation will create a second EXP-596, colliding with the existing entry.
issues.suggested_fix: Set next_id=597 in expansion-tracker.json. Also consider moving EXP-596 to the archive since status=complete (live-archive disjointness is OK currently, but this would also increment live_max and prevent the false-positive from recurring). Investigate the writer that allocated EXP-596 without incrementing next_id.
